newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BESI in joint venture with German Possehl.
newsitem.headline: BESI in joint venture with German Possehl.

text.p: BE Semiconductor Industries (BESI) said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent with Germany's L. Possehl & Co and Possehl's Far East operations manager Ho Hung Tak to form a joint venture.
The new company, to be named Possehl BESI Electronic NV (PBE), will combine the leadframe stamping, etching, tooling, and plating operations of the three contributing entities.

PBE has estimated pro forma 1996 sales 300 million guilders, will employ approximately 1,250 people and operate 14 production facilities in Europe, Asia, the United States and North Africa, BESI said in a statement.
Each participating entity will contribute all of its ownership interests relating to production and plating of leadframes and connectors, BESI said.
"Ownership of the new company by Possehl, BESI and Mr. Ho will be 50.1 percent, 30 percent and 19.9 percent respectively," it added.
